Project Name: Memorial Hermann TMC Jones CT Renovation
Facility Name: Memorial Hermann Texas Medical Center - Jones Pavilion
Type of Funds: This project is privately funded, on private land for private use.
Scope of Work: Located on Level 02 of Memorial Hermann TMC Jones Pavilion, Houston, Texas. The scope of the project includes the replacement of CT imaging equipment and the minor renovation of an existing CT room, including new finishes.
